title: frangula capreifolia var. grandifolia
intro: Frangula capreifolia var. grandifolia, commonly known as the "Giant Buckthorn", is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural laxative due to its high anthraquinone content. The therapeutic actions of Frangula capreifolia var. grandifolia include stimulating bowel movements, reducing fever, and treating various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and chrysophanol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
